_units: cg_brief queue item 2.0 (Captain, 2026-10-22: "make sure it follows the current standards for armor"): the two protection standards the game rates armour by, read by ArmourStandards. nij_0101_07: personal armour, NIJ Standard 0101.07 (2023). levels weakest first (Ballistics.LEVELS between FRAGMENT and ABOVE_RF3); threats per level: round (data/rounds.json id), name (the standard's test round), mps (the standard's reference velocity), range_m (the test range: 5 m handgun, 15 m rifle); includes: a level whose list also takes another's (RF2 = RF1 plus M855). legacy: 0101.06 names and the game's old III+/III++ (Ballistics.LEGACY_LEVELS reads them). stanag_4569: vehicles, NATO STANAG 4569 / AEP-55 Vol 1 (KE and artillery) and Vol 2 (mine blast). ke levels 1-6: threats are a shells.json id (shell) or a reference row in ke_reference (rifle-calibre test rounds: in game they stay on VehicleDamage's tiers, docs/combined_arms.md call 79), each at the standard's range_m; elevations_deg: the round's angle down from level; arc: all (levels 1-4, rated per arc front/side/rear) or front (levels 5-6: the frontal +/-30 degrees only, the sides staying at 4). artillery levels 1-6: a 155 mm HE burst burst_m away, its worst fragment as a 20 mm FSP of frag_pen_mm RHA (Proposed, from the AEP-55 fragment velocities), all round at elevations_deg. mine levels 1, 2a-4b: kg TNT under a wheel or track station (a) or the belly (b); level 1 is a grenade or small AP mine anywhere under. mine_proof (Proposed, docs/combined_arms.md 2.3.6: the belly's blast share of the charge reaches the crew floor, blast seats halve the leg injury): a hull holds a mine when kg x station_share x belly.blast x (blast_seat_mult with blast seats) <= floor_kg; a model without a belly is not mine rated. arcs: azimuth samples (degrees off the front, + to the right) per arc. ke_reference rows read like data/shells.json rows. Vehicles store their ratings in data/vehicle_armour.json (stanag_ke per arc, stanag_artillery, stanag_mine {wheel, belly}); a package's own values replace the base's while it's fitted. Plates with "stanag": false (tyres, an MRAP's bonnet, the open gunner's shield) are outside the rated crew envelope. Every number is Proposed, rounded from public summaries of the standards.
